action_items: MINOR (optional): AuthContext.tsx AppState listener at line 91-100 imports startForegroundWatcher but does NOT invoke it on 'active' — only drainQueue + syncOfficeGeofence. Functionally the watcher is still restarted on foreground via PermissionsGate's own AppState listener (line 58-63 of PermissionsGate.tsx which calls check() -> startForegroundWatcher) AND via HomeScreen's mount useEffect, so live behavior is correct. But the checklist item literally asks for the call to also live in AuthContext. Consider adding `startForegroundWatcher().catch(() => undefined);` alongside drainQueue in the AppState 'active' branch for defence in depth (e.g. if HomeScreen is unmounted for a modal + PermissionsGate is bypassed). Not a functional bug — watcher lifecycle is already covered.
critical_code_review_comments: foregroundWatcher hysteresis + debounce logic is sound: fuzzy band (r-15 .. r+15) returns without state change, first-fix establishes baseline without firing, and 30 s debounce guards against rapid re-cross. Naming `fg-` for client_event_id will not collide with native `ce-` events so server unique index dedup is preserved.
PermissionsGate correctly re-evaluates on AppState 'active' — this is critical for the Settings round-trip UX and matches the fix intent.
HomeScreen restarts watcher when office.id or radius_meters changes (line 36-40) — good, handles admin reassignment without app restart.
signOut in AuthContext correctly stops watcher before clearing tokens — no leaked subscription.

rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration validates a fix from iteration 18. Original RCA (from problem statement): (a) PermissionsScreen was orphaned from RootNavigator so users never granted bg location; (b) registerOfficeGeofence silently no-op'd without bg perm; (c) no foreground watcher meant reliance on 30-90s-lag native geofences; (d) Android 10+ requires ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION for startGeofencingAsync even when foreground. The applied fix (PermissionsGate + foregroundWatcher + amber CTA banner + AuthContext hooks) addresses all four causes in the code base as verified.
